protocol: Digit OCR (tesseract, psm 7, digit whitelist) on fixed crops; scale per field: gold and streak 3x, level and XP 6x. The script does not open the master; the master is compared after OCR. Gold and streak crops were chosen after seeing the sample of ten (tuned). Level and XP crops were calibrated on the out-of-sample frame 2-3 at 604 s before the sample run.

gold.note: planning-frame run, 3x; tuned crop; 10/10 after 5-5's master frame label was moved from 2094 to 2095 s (the earlier run gave 9/10 with that label)

streak.note: planning-frame run, 3x; tuned crop; miss 6-2 is an empty OCR read, frame shows 1

level.note: planning-frame run, 6x; calibrated on out-of-sample 2-3 at 604 s

gold_masked_near_white.note: near-white mask (min RGB > 200), 4x nearest upscale, digit whitelist psm 7; several frames gave no digits, so the 71/57/9 two-digit golds are cut or unreadable in this crop. Not an improvement over the unmasked 4/10.

time_check.result: all 10 blind-pick times equal the Frame A times

gold_original_crop.note: coin and neighbouring digits leak in

miss.6-2: OCR returned empty; frame at 2342 s shows 1, master 1 confirmed

gold_frame_a_run.note: Earlier run at Frame A times; superseded by the planning-frame run above

level_xp_protocol: Calibration on one out-of-sample frame (2-3 at 604 s) before the sample run; the ten sample rounds read at their planning frames.
script: data/hud-audit/blind_ocr_planning.py (planning-frame run for all four fields, per-field scale)
